scope: Independent read-only logic and synthetic review; no real or reserved audio opened

old_finding.issue: describe verifies WAV PCM before wavfile.read but never binds the actual loaded measurement array to that PCM identity. Concurrent replacement is measured successfully while decoded_pcm still claims the old source.
old_finding.synthetic_proof: At the second WAV read, correct opposite-phase stereo was replaced with an in-phase fixture. Returned measured correlation changed−1→+1 while decoded_pcm retained the old identity.
old_finding.recommended_fix: Hash loaded PCM24 array bytes and compare to pinned source PCM before feature extraction; optionally recheck source files afterward.

resolution: WAV bytes are snapshotted and container-hashed; the actual loaded PCM24 array, rate, channels and frames are authenticated before features. Returned identity describes that loaded array.

formula_review.fft: One-sided Hann-window stereo-power normalization passes Parseval; it is window-weighted power, not unweighted integrated event energy.
formula_review.censoring: Requested windows stop at real sample support; short support flagged, no time padding.
formula_review.preset: Nominal free-source coverage explicitly excludes the connected body/string response.
